method: R1 blind suread (subagent read text only, no md/rules)

facts.fact: Hattie 拉下客厅所有遮光帘以便看海湾。
facts.anchor: She’s pulled all the shades in the den so she can see the bay.

facts.fact: Tommy 端一杯热咖啡放到她身旁后在另一把椅子坐下。
facts.anchor: Tommy sets a steaming cup of coffee beside her before settling into another chair.

facts.fact: Tommy 向妈妈道歉说对不起。
Hattie 点亮手机并推向 Tommy，打开与 Kevin 的短信串。
facts.anchor: she wakes her phone and slides it toward him.

facts.fact: Kevin 最后一条短信写着离我的家人远点。
Hattie 端蛋和吐司时看见院子边站着一个小身影。
facts.anchor: A small figure stands at the edge of the yard.

facts.fact: 雾中 Julian 是树旁的一个小轮廓，Hattie 感觉他在盯着她。
facts.anchor: Julian is just a small shape near the trees.

facts.fact: Kevin 在树林间大声喊 Jules 快走。
facts.anchor: “Jules! Where are you? We gotta go!”

facts.fact: Julian 最后看了她一眼后冲进雾林消失。
facts.anchor: He gives her a final look, then darts into the fog-laced trees and is gone.
